events.rationale: Pay CRAH27 to fade the existing 4.45bn CORRA Mar27 receive. Cheapness versus cash 2.26 is the crowded idea, not an unowned entry.
Cut 25 million of the 50 million Canada March short. The implied yield has already fallen from 2.995 to 2.885, and the leftover gap versus cash is no longer a special outlier.

March SOFR at 4.315 versus 3.89 cash and March CORRA at 2.885 versus 2.52 cash already carry a public December hike, so a new front-end pay chases a repriced path and a new receive is the obvious trade ahead of an unreleased CPI. The March 2027 CORRA pay is the stale line: sold at 3.00 and marked 2.835, so that bucket has already been received. Ten million of the 25 million short-duration notional comes off, and a 15 million stub stays. AUDNZD stays short from 1.25 to 1.239 with the cross still at the 82nd percentile. The NZDUSD jump at the fourth percentile can still be a squeeze, so there is no add.

invalidation: The pay is wrong if CRAH27 implied keeps compressing toward CORRA cash 2.26 while the existing receive stays on, or if Canada inflation/oil pressure reverses with labor still cool.
